content.title: Manipulate strings with Power Fx: replace characters
content.problem: Transform text in a Power Automate Desktop flow using Power Fx. The initial example replaces forward slashes with underscores; variable names and replacement characters are samples to adapt to the current flow.
content.approach: Use Substitute in a Robin SET action to produce the transformed text. Sample input: 22/09/2026; expected output: 22_09_2026. Keep this pattern ID when adding further real string manipulation cases, and update the description and tags to reflect the cases actually included.
inputs: Source text (Text). Sample variable: t_DataFileOutput, initialized before this action; sample value: 22/09/2026. Map it to the source variable in the actual flow.
outputs: Transformed text (Text). Sample variable: t_SetDataFileOutput; expected sample value: 22_09_2026. Map it to the destination variable in the actual flow.
dependencies: Power Fx enabled in the Power Automate Desktop flow.
pitfalls: This example replaces a character in text; it does not parse or format a date, even when the sample text looks like a date.
Replacing forward slashes alone is not a complete filename sanitization routine.
content.compatibility: Power Automate Desktop with Power Fx enabled. No PAD version was supplied.
content.provenance: Robin code preserved from the user's legacy development prompt. Consolidated into one extensible string manipulation snippet at the user's request.
